title: Nature tour in the city
text: This was a wonderful tour at Park Güell. Esther was an excellent tour guide. She was funny, engaging, and deeply knowledgeable about the park. Not only did she take us to all the famous spots but she also recommended places in the park to visit once the tour was over. As both a first time visitor to the park and a solo traveler, this was an excellent way to experience Park Güell.

title: Park Guell is something out of a fairytale
text: Park Guell is a gem outside of the downtown core.  The imagination and artistic genius of Antoni Gaudi, a lover of nature is alive and rich with history that is not long ago.  Our guide Mark was very knowledgeable and helped us get the most out of our Park Guell experience.
